title: Palak Tofu
subtitle: vegan spinach and tofu curry
description: A vegan take on palak paneer: pureed spinach is simmered with spiced onion and tomato, finished with coconut butter and tossed with tofu.

steps.text: Blanch the spinach in plenty of boiling water for about 5 minutes until soft. Drain and blend in a food processor for 5 minutes to a smooth puree.

Heat the olive oil in a deep pan and fry the finely chopped onion over medium heat for 5 minutes until golden. Add the chilli and grated ginger and stir. Add the crushed garlic and fry for 1 minute, stirring. Add the diced tomatoes, garam masala and salt and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the spinach puree and cook for 2 minutes, stirring. Add the coconut butter and stir for 1 minute. Add the tofu and stir until it is coated in the sauce. Serve immediately.
